payload.body_you: You and {{holder1}} talk about getting away next month, and by the end of the night you are already thinking about dates. The problem is that neither of you actually booked anything or agreed on a plan. It can be easy to hear certainty in a conversation that was still only an idea.
payload.body_they: You stay up talking with {{holder1}}, mention something the two of you could do later, or send a message that feels especially warm. {{holder1}} can start planning around it before the two of you have actually agreed to anything. What felt open-ended to you may feel much more definite to {{holder1}}.
